purpose: Small family-balanced synthetic foundation curriculum after the aesthetic RL coverage failure.
hypothesis: Two verified complete procedural targets per family restore broad structural and paint-handling coverage; the separately reserved -008 targets support teacher development only and must not be treated as unseen transfer evidence.
matched_baseline: aesthetic-rl-20260921 admitted only v2-box-000 and v2-bus-000 despite a 24-state manifest; this candidate distributes 24 train groups across 12 families.

renderer_contract.inspection: view_image direct inspection of every selected PNG; no rerender or model inference

data_semantics.target: complete synthetic painted canvas from known procedural program
data_semantics.photo_reference_note: No local photo PNG/JPEG/WebP payloads were found; Astra manual collection mirror contains metadata/cache only and is not ready data.
data_semantics.teacher_vs_rl: A procedural teacher target may equal its reference for SFT. Never use that equality as an RL opponent; supply a distinct reviewed student/correction canvas.

scheduler.heldout_semantics: reserved_next_run_teacher_development_only; -008 is pretraining/package-exposed and not a clean unseen evaluation split
scheduler.recommended_next_mix: 24 selected already-prepared references plus separately audited repair examples; do not claim new-reference novelty or silently mine old evaluation outputs
scheduler.reward: keep simple aesthetic reward; no speed/validity/finish add-ons

not_selected: all v2-*-007 and all v3 heldouts; no photo metadata-only records; no malformed old student output as teacher target

exposure_audit.v2_000_001: Already exposed in revision-rl-20260918/inputs/rl-states.json and reused by the aesthetic-rl-20260921 state inventory; the prior admitted RL episodes were only v2-box-000 and v2-bus-000.
exposure_audit.v2_008: All twelve -008 source groups are explicitly split=train in painter/data-v2/manifest.jsonl and their turn-1/2/3 assets also appear in the revision-rl-20260918 async-restart package manifest. They do not appear in revision-rl-20260918/rl-states.json or the admitted aesthetic-rl-20260921 training_scope; this establishes manifest/package exposure, not gradient-use proof. They are therefore reserved from this candidate's train split and must not be called novel or unseen.
exposure_audit.honest_label: This manifest is a split/role repair over previously prepared synthetic data. It must not claim new-reference novelty or clean checkpoint generalization for -008.
